class.name: GIFSprite2D
class.brief_description: Draws a [GIFAnimation] in 2D with Sprite2D-like offset and centering.
class.description: Plays an animation with per-frame delays. Negative [member speed_scale] reverses playback. When the animation uses source display mode, each patch is drawn at its GIF origin.

method.name: pause
method.description: Stops advancing frames without resetting the playhead.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops playback and returns to the first frame.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the canvas is centered on the node's origin.
Playback speed. Negative values play in reverse.
